claims.text: The driver's own trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous 360 seconds, from 07:39:37 to 07:45:37, which is longer than the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip. On the face of the GPS record the dwell limb of the no-show test is met, and I do not contest it.

The rider was at the pin the whole time. The rider's track shows 66 fixes, all stationary (distinct speed 0.0 kph), never more than 10.55 m from the pickup pin and on average 6.73 m from it - well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. The rider did not wander off; the rider was standing at the pickup point.

The rider was actively coordinating and the driver never answered. The rider's message 'ok' was sent at 07:41:07 and read by the driver at 07:41:17, and the driver posted no reply at any point before cancelling at 07:45:40 - a silence of more than four minutes, far beyond the 120 second window in POL-NS-04(b). The driver's only message, 'here', was sent before the rider's and drew no engagement from the driver afterwards.

The rider's claim that the driver 'parked a bit away' is corroborated by the driver's own track: the driver's minimum recorded distance from the pin across the whole trace is 41.42 m, and his mean distance is 829.97 m. The driver's closest approach to the pickup pin was 41.42 m - outside the 50 m arrival radius is not established, but the trace shows he never closed to the pin itself, which is consistent with the rider's account of a driver who stopped short.

The rider has no history of no-show abuse: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0. There is no pattern of repeat no-show disputes between this rider and this driver, so the escalation trigger in POL-NS-09(c) and (d) is not engaged on the rider's side.

The driver's profile shows one no-show termination in the trailing 30 days against 133 completed trips, a rate of 0.0075 - far below the 0.08 threshold, and the absolute count of 1 is below the 4 required. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, so the driver's compensation is not withheld on that ground. I note this against my own side because the record does not support an anti-farming argument here.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING - no advisory covers Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6 in this window. Under POL-NS-06(i) a MISSING traffic_advisory makes the accumulated-dwell limb unavailable, so the driver cannot rely on it to extend or excuse anything. The absence is itself citable and it removes the only route by which the driver could have argued that holding position was not lawfully possible.

The fare ledger shows the rider was charged SGD 4.50 with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The rider is presently carrying the disputed charge, and the amount contested is exactly that cancellation-fee line.

claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous qualifying run of 360 seconds, from 07:39:37 to 07:45:37, with 37 qualifying fixes — comfortably past the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). POL-NS-01 limb (c) is therefore satisfied on the driver's own evidence, and the dwell is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the arrival tap.

The trip_record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 07:39:37 and the GPS trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at the same 07:39:37 timestamp, so limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is met on the record's own clock: the driver was inside the geofence at or before the arrival event. The trace shows no clock skew — the arrival event and the first in-geofence fix agree to the second, well inside the 90 second tolerance of POL-NS-08(a).

The trip was terminated by the driver at 07:45:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three reason codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and the termination falls after the 180 second dwell elapsed at 07:42:37. No boarding event is recorded. Limb (d) is satisfied.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: the driver's minimum distance to the pin across the trace is 41.4 m, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and the trace shows a stationary speed of 0.0 kph during the qualifying run. The marker was not tapped from an expressway or arterial road, so the waiting clock is not recomputed and the 360 second dwell stands as measured.

The rider's own track places her device within the 100 m STANDARD rider_presence_radius_m for the whole window — 66 qualifying fixes, mean distance 6.7 m from the pin, maximum 10.5 m — so the rider was at the pickup point and simply did not board. This is not a wrong-entrance case under POL-NS-03: the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and the rider was at the pin.

The rider's chat message 'ok' at 07:41:07 is not a locating or coordinating message — it is an acknowledgement of the driver's 'here' at 07:39:57. POL-NS-04 limb (a) requires the rider to have sent a message whose content is locating or coordinating (their own position, an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, a request for the driver's position, or a statement that they cannot see the vehicle). 'ok' is none of those, so POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider and the fee is not refunded on that route.

The fare_breakdown reconciles with the fee schedule: the cancellation_fee line is 4.50 SGD, which equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd for this trip, and the payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0. There is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect, and the fee is chargeable in the net amount fixed by fee_schedule.resolution_rule.

The driver is entitled to compensation under POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the cancellation fee in force: 80 percent of 4.50 SGD is 3.60 SGD, which the fare_breakdown's own derived money block computes as driver_compensation. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d (133) is 0.0075, far below the 0.08 rate test. Both limbs must hold for compensation to be withheld, and neither does.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02719-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0, so POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable: there is no advisory to permit separate in-geofence intervals to be summed. That limb is not needed here — the driver's dwell is a single continuous 360 second run, already above the 180 second minimum — and the absence of an advisory does not reduce the required minimum or excuse any shortfall.

The rider's claim that the driver 'parked a bit away' is contradicted by the driver's own trace: the minimum distance to the pin is 41.4 m, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and the driver held position there for 360 seconds. The rider's assertion is not supported by the GPS evidence, and the driver's counterparty statement 'I was right at the pin' is corroborated by the trace.

The rider's profile shows no_show_disputes_30d of 0 and disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, and the driver's profile shows disputes_with_counterparty_90d of 0, so neither POL-NS-09(c) nor POL-NS-09(d) is engaged. There is no pattern of repeat no-show disputes between these parties and no abuse signal that would require escalation.

The GPS trace is COMPLETE with weight 1.0: 100 percent coverage, 67 fixes at 10 second intervals, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, and both driver and rider tracks present. There is no POL-NS-08 impairment — no clock skew, no trace defect, no chat defect, no fare defect — so the deciding facts rest on clean evidence and the confidence cap under POL-GEN-02(2) is 1.0.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. This is an automated provisional ruling; either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04. Outcome: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee on trip TRP-02719 stands and is not refunded, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60, being 80% of that fee under POL-NS-07. The money this ruling moves (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, so it executes on issue.

Why the fee stands (driver's case). All four limbs of the no-show test in POL-NS-01 hold. (a) EV-TRIP-02719 records a driver 'arrived' event at 07:39:37. (b) EV-GPS-02719 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius (fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m) at that same second: the first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 07:39:37, offset 0.0 s from the arrival marker, so the POL-NS-08(a) 90-second clock-skew tolerance is comfortably met. (c) The trace shows one continuous in-geofence run of 360.0 seconds, 07:39:37 to 07:45:37, over 37 qualifying fixes at a 10 s cadence; the free waiting period in force is trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180 s, so the dwell is twice the minimum, and the clock is correctly run from the first qualifying in-geofence fix rather than from the arrival tap. (d) No boarding event is recorded and the driver terminated the trip at 07:45:40 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, after the dwell elapsed at 07:42:37.

Claims I have considered and rejected. (1) 'He parked a bit away': the driver's closest recorded position was 41.42 m from the pin (EV-GPS-02719, derived.driver_track.min_distance_m). That is inside the 50 m arrival radius, so POL-NS-02 deems the driver to have arrived at the pickup point; stopping short while still inside the radius is not a failure to arrive. The mean distance of 829.97 m in the same data is the average across the whole trace, including the drive in from outside the geofence, and is not the waiting position. For the same reason POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes are inside the radius, not outside it within 400 m. (2) POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider, because limb (a) fails: the only message the rider sent in the waiting window was 'ok' at 07:41:07, an acknowledgement of the driver's 'here', not a message whose content is locating or coordinating (own position, an entrance/block/tower/bay, a request for the driver's position, or a statement they cannot see the vehicle). Limb (a) must hold alongside limbs (b) and (c). Limb (c) is in fact satisfied (66 rider fixes, all within 10.55 m of the pin, inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius) and limb (b) is satisfied (no driver reply within 120 s), but with limb (a) failed the clause does not apply; POL-NS-11 is not engaged because the rider track is present and runnable. (3) POL-NS-05 does not help: the arrival marker is truthful — at 07:39:37 the driver was 41.4 m from the pin, far inside the 300 m test, and stationary at 0.0 kph, far below 15 kph — so the waiting clock is not recomputed and no false-arrival referral arises. (4) POL-NS-06 yields no shortfall: the effective dwell of 360 s exceeds the 180 s minimum, so no refund follows on that route.

Compensation. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80% of the fee in force: 0.8 x SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60, the same figure the fare breakdown's money block computes. The anti-farming check does not trip and compensation is not withheld: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below the 4 required) and 1 / 133 completed trips = 0.0075 (below the 0.08 rate test), and both limbs must hold to withhold. Under POL-GEN-03 a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling carries the same figure in amount_sgd and driver_compensation_sgd, so both read SGD 3.60; the rider's own charge is unaffected.

Evidence weight and integrity. No artifact below weight 1.0 carries any deciding fact. Arrival and dwell rest on EV-GPS-02719 and EV-TRIP-02719, both weight 1.0 and COMPLETE (100% coverage, 67 fixes, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0), and the fee amount reconciles on EV-FARE-02719, weight 1.0 (cancellation_fee 4.50 = platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so no POL-NS-08(d) defect). The POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap is therefore 1.0 and confidence is stated at 0.90. EV-ADVIS-02719-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); it carries no fact and nothing in this ruling rests on it. Its only effect is to make the accumulated-dwell limb POL-NS-06(i) unavailable, which does not matter here because the dwell is a single continuous run that exceeds the minimum on its own. Two claims built on that artifact were discarded by the referee for citing it without disclosing its impairment, and the outcome is unchanged without them.

Escalation and referrals. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence (the parties' statements are resolved by the trace and by POL-NS-02's radius); the parties have no repeat no-show disputes in the last 90 days (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0); the anti-farming check does not trip and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the deciding evidence is not impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d). There is accordingly no clause-mandated referral: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker was true, POL-RD-09(4) does not fire because the fare reconciles and there are no ERP gantries on this trip, and POL-NS-07's escalation packet is not produced because its anti-farming branch did not trip.

ruling.explanation: To the rider: your booking was terminated by the driver at 07:45:40 under the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, and you were charged the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee. The driver's own GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 07:39:37 to 07:45:37 — a continuous qualifying dwell of 360 seconds (37 in-radius fixes) against the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). The 'arrived' event at 07:39:37 matches the first in-geofence fix to the second, so limb (b) holds with no clock skew, and the marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at the marker the driver was 41.4 m from the pin and stationary, not moving at 15 km/h or more. The cancellation at 07:45:40 falls after the dwell elapsed at 07:42:37, with no boarding event and a recognised reason code, so limb (d) holds. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them: you were not at a wrong entrance (the driver was inside the radius, not outside it), the dwell is not short of the minimum, and the MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02719-01) does not reduce the required minimum or excuse anything. Your statement that the driver 'parked a bit away' is not borne out — his closest recorded approach was 41.4 m, inside the 50 m radius — and your own track shows you at the pin (never more than 10.5 m away) throughout. Your chat message 'ok' at 07:41:07 is an acknowledgement of the driver's 'here', not a locating or coordinating message (it states no position, entrance, block, bay or request for the driver's position), so POL-NS-04 limb (a) fails and that clause does not exonerate you. The SGD 4.50 fee therefore stands. To the driver: the fee stands and POL-NS-07 fixes your compensation at 80% of the SGD 4.50 fee in force, i.e. SGD 3.60. The anti-farming check does not trip (1 no-show termination in the trailing 30 days, below the required 4; and 1/133 = 0.0075, below the 0.08 rate test), so compensation is paid rather than withheld and the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION. Your counterparty statement that you were 'right at the pin' is corroborated by the trace. No escalation trigger is engaged: both profiles show zero disputes with each other in the last 90 days, no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and no admissible artifact contradicts the GPS on arrival or dwell. The deciding facts rest on the GPS trace and the trip record, both at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is 0.95; the MISSING advisory at weight 0.0 carries no fact this ruling uses. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you agree on the decisive facts, and the record supports them. The driver tapped "I'm Here" at 07:39:37 and the GPS trace shows his first in-geofence fix at the same second, so there is no clock skew under POL-NS-08(a). He then held position inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous 360 seconds (37 qualifying fixes, 07:39:37 to 07:45:37), which is twice the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). The trip was cancelled by the driver at 07:45:40 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed at 07:42:37, and no boarding event is recorded. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are therefore satisfied on EV-TRIP-02719 and EV-GPS-02719, and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the charge: there is no waiting-period shortfall (360 s measured against a 180 s minimum, shortfall -180 s), and the arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05 because at 07:39:37 the driver was 41.4 m from the pin and stationary (0.0 kph).

Rider: your account that the driver "parked a bit away" is not supported by the evidence. His minimum recorded distance from the pickup pin is 41.42 m, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius (fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m), with 37 qualifying in-radius fixes, so he did arrive at the pickup point under POL-NS-02 (EV-GPS-02719). Your own track confirms you were at the pin throughout (66 qualifying fixes, all stationary, mean 6.73 m and maximum 10.55 m from the pin), so this is not a wrong-entrance case under POL-NS-03 either. Your message "ok" at 07:41:07 is an acknowledgement of the driver's "here", not a locating or coordinating message of the kind POL-NS-04(a) enumerates, so POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you and refunds nothing (EV-CHAT-02719). Your points that there is no repeat-dispute pattern (POL-NS-09(c)/(d)) and that the anti-farming check does not trip are accepted, but they do not change the outcome.

Driver: your account is corroborated by your own trace. The anti-farming check in POL-NS-07 does not trip - 1 no-show termination in the trailing 30 days against 133 completed trips, a rate of 0.0075, both limbs below the thresholds (4 or more, and above 0.08) - so compensation is not withheld.

Result: the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 charged on EV-FARE-02719 stands as it presently is (the fee limb is NO_ACTION), and the driver is compensated SGD 3.60, being 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force under POL-NS-07 (the same figure computed in EV-FARE-02719's money block). Because the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, amount_sgd carries that same SGD 3.60 figure; it is not a refund to the rider and nothing is returned to you, rider.

No clause produces a referral. The arrival marker was not false, so POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire; the driver's reason code was RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is a recognised limb (d) code, so the POL-NS-01 education referral is not engaged; and no anti-farming escalation under POL-NS-07 arises. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02719-01 (weight 0.0) is not relied on by the finding: POL-NS-06(i) accumulated dwell is not needed because the dwell is a single continuous run, and the absence of an advisory neither reduces the required minimum nor excuses any shortfall, so it changes nothing.

Confidence is 0.90. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact - EV-TRIP-02719, EV-GPS-02719, EV-CHAT-02719 and EV-FARE-02719 - carries full weight 1.0, the trace is complete (100 percent coverage, 67 fixes at 10 s, no gaps), the chat reconciles with chat_message_count, and the fare line reconciles with the fee in force, so nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08 and the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged. The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, so it executes automatically. Both of you may appeal this provisional ruling once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation: Rider — your dispute is not supported, and the driver is owed compensation. The record shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 07:39:37 and the GPS trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from that same second, holding position in one continuous 360-second run (37 qualifying in-radius fixes, ending 07:45:37) until he cancelled at 07:45:40 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. That is longer than the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), and no_show_threshold_sec is unset, so limbs (a) to (d) of POL-NS-01 all hold. Your account that he 'parked a bit away' is not borne out: his closest approach was 41.42 m from the pin — inside the 50 m arrival radius — and his counterparty statement 'I was right at the pin' is consistent with the trace. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: at the arrival marker he was stationary (0.0 kph) inside the radius, not more than 300 m away and not moving at 15 kph or more, so the marker is not false and no false-arrival referral is recorded. Your two answers fail. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you: limb (a) requires a message that is locating or coordinating, and your only message, 'ok' at 07:41:07, is an acknowledgement of the driver's 'here' at 07:39:57 — not a position, entrance, block or bay — so the clause does not fire on limb (a) whatever limb (b) shows. POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver was stationary inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and your own device sat at the pin (66 stationary fixes, mean 6.7 m, maximum 10.5 m from it, inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius), so this is a rider no-show, not a wrong-face-of-the-venue case. Driver — the SGD 4.50 fee stands and POL-NS-07 pays you 80 percent of it: SGD 3.60, the same figure the fare ledger's money block computes. The anti-farming check does not trip (1 no-show termination in 30 days, below the count of 4; 1 divided by 133 completed trips = 0.0075, below the 0.08 rate), so nothing is withheld. Confidence: the deciding facts rest on the trip record, the GPS trace, the fare breakdown and the driver profile, all COMPLETE at weight 1.0 — no clock skew (the arrival event and the first in-geofence fix agree to the second, well inside POL-NS-08(a)), no trace gap (100 percent coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0), no chat defect (2 messages, sequence intact) and no fare defect (the 4.50 line equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so POL-NS-08(d) is clean). No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: both tracks are present, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, there is no repeat-party pattern (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0), the anti-farming check is clear, and confidence is above the 0.70 floor. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02719-01, weight 0.0) changes nothing: no accumulation across separate in-geofence intervals is needed on a single continuous 360-second run, and the claims that cited it were discarded at the mechanical check for not naming its issue code. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this ruling executes automatically; either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
